args:
# Marketplace entrypoint for Cursor and Grok. This shell must not load agent.env.
# The botrelay_mcp package must load ~/.config/botrelay/agent.env on startup.
py="$BOTRELAY_PYTHON"
case "$py" in
  ""|*'${'*) py="" ;;
  "~/"*) py="$HOME/${py#"~/"}" ;;
esac
can_import() {
  [ -n "$1" ] && [ -x "$1" ] && "$1" -c "import botrelay_mcp" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
if ! can_import "$py"; then
  py=""
  for c in \
    "$HOME/.venvs/botrelay/bin/python3" \
    "$HOME/.venvs/botrelay/bin/python" \
    "$HOME/.venvs/botrelay/Scripts/python.exe"
  do
    if can_import "$c"; then
      py="$c"
      break
    fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$py" ]; then
  echo "botrelay-mcp is not importable." >&2
  echo 'Customer install: python3 -m venv "$HOME/.venvs/botrelay" && "$HOME/.venvs/botrelay/bin/pip" install botrelay-mcp botrelay-cli' >&2
  echo "Or set BOTRELAY_PYTHON to that venv's python." >&2
  exit 1
fi
exec "$py" -m botrelay_mcp "$@"
